messages:
Sasha: Auditor asked for proof that the RBAC change to svc-inference-writer (namespace=prod) only happened via the approved change and that KMS decrypts tied to the triage incident are recorded. They want chain-of-custody + minimal bundle we can hand over. Any suggestions on what to include?
Liam: Minimal bundle: PR/CL links, k8s audit log snippets showing the RoleBinding change, cloud provider IAM change event, CloudTrail or equivalent, KMS Decrypt/Encrypt events (key alias + requestor principal), and the incident ticket linking the vuln triage. Also include a manifest file listing filenames + hashes.
Sasha: Are we okay with redacting token values and IP addresses? Auditor said they need requestor principal and timestamps but not session tokens.
Jane_auditor: Redactions are fine as long as we keep principal, timestamp, action, resource, and request ID. We'll validate hashing & manifest signatures. Also need evidence of key rotation policy: last rotation date and rotation process doc/attestation.
Marta: For k8s audit, we can run this query to extract the RoleBinding change around the window:```
# kubectl get events --namespace prod --field-selector involvedObject.name=svc-inference-writer
kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-audit --since=72h | jq 'select(.objectRef.name=="svc-inference-writer")'```
Liam: For cloud logs, a compact Splunk/ELK example we use:```
index=cloud_logs source=cloudtrail eventName=UpdateRole OR eventName=PutRolePolicy userIdentity.principalId="*" | table _time userIdentity.principalId eventName requestParameters
``` Include KMS events:```
index=cloud_logs source=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=Encrypt resource=arn:aws:kms:*:123456789012:key/* | table _time userIdentity.principalArn eventName requestParameters.keyId awsRegion
```
Sasha: I'll assemble a presigned S3 bundle with the logs + manifest. Any objections to including the raw CloudTrail lines?
Jane_auditor: Raw lines ok if redacted per above. Also need verification that artifacts are immutable (object lock or signed manifest). A detached signature on the manifest is good.
Marta: We can sign the manifest with the compliance key (alias/rdw-compliance-manifests). That key is in KMS; signing proof will show key usage. We'll also include the rotation record: last_rotated=2026-01-12 and rotation runbook link.
Liam: For chain-of-custody, include: who exported, command used, sha256 of the bundle, and S3 presigned url expiry. Example manifest fields: [filename, sha256, produced_by, export_command, produced_at, redaction_notes].
deploybot: automated-archiver: bundle created: s3://redwood-audit-exports/1849991234/svc-inference-writer-bundle.tar.gz (presigned link expires in 7 days) :package:
Sasha: I uploaded the bundle. Presigned link sent via secure transfer to the auditor. Manifest.json included and signed.
Jane_auditor: Received sample, thank you. Quick follow-up: can you also provide proof that during the vuln triage window we did not use a different key alias (need keyId list)?
Liam: Yes — will include KMS event list of keyIds and a short mapping doc: alias -> keyId -> created_at -> rotation_at.
Sasha: Action items: (1) Liam export CloudTrail + KMS events for 2026-02-10 09:00 to 2026-02-10 12:00. (2) Marta attach runbook + rotation attestation. (3) Sasha produce signed manifest + presigned bundle. (4) Jane to confirm sufficiency.
Jane_auditor: Sounds good. Once we validate hashes & signatures we'll close this request. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Marta: I'll also note the vuln triage incident ID: VT-2026-0423 in the bundle for traceability.
Sasha: Done, bundle updated with VT-2026-0423 reference and export metadata.
Liam: Uploading KMS event CSV now. ETA 8m.
Sasha: Closing thread once Jane confirms.
Jane_auditor: Confirmed receipt and initial validation passed. Will revert with final sign-off within 48h.
